title: Property
subtitle: Details and branding shown on the guest site, in emails and on confirmations

missing.title: Setup isn't complete.
missing.text: Missing: {{items}}. The guest site still works, but guests won't see these.

sections.generalHint: The name and the words on the home page photo. Shown as typed in every language.
sections.brandHint: The logo is used on the site, in emails and on PDFs. The photo sits behind the search box on the home page.
sections.contactHint: Shown in the footer, emails and confirmations.
sections.timesHint: Shown on room pages, emails and confirmations.
sections.cancelHint: Applies to new bookings. Existing bookings keep the policy they were made under.
sections.listsHint: The home page's Amenities and Location sections. An empty list hides its section.

errors.email: Enter a full email address, e.g. stay@yourhotel.com
errors.phone: Use digits, +, spaces, dashes or brackets only (6–30 characters).
errors.rowName: Every row with text needs a name.

cancel.after: Paid bookings can be cancelled and refunded online until this point. After it, guests contact the property. Set 0 to allow it until the day before check-in.

image.savedAtOnce: The logo and photo are saved as soon as they are uploaded or removed.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 10 MB; a transparent background works best. Without a logo the site shows the name's first letter. PDFs use a PNG made automatically.

hero.title: Home page photo
hero.hint: A landscape photo up to 10 MB; scaled to at most 2400 px, turned the right way up and stripped of location data. Only use photos you have the right to use.
hero.none: No photo: the home page uses a plain colour

preview.label: Preview
preview.noContact: No phone number or address yet
preview.freeCancel: Free cancellation up to {{count}} days before
preview.freeCancel_one: Free cancellation up to {{count}} day before
preview.note: The preview follows your edits. Guests see changes only after you save.

home.amenitiesHint: {{count}}/{{max}} rows. Shown in the home page's Amenities section.
home.nearbyPlacesHint: {{count}}/{{max}} rows. Shown in the home page's Location section, with the address above.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.subtitle: Destination photos and their credits
destinations.lede: Destinations come from the rooms' addresses (the part after the last comma), so they are added and removed with the rooms. The photo shows on the home page's Destinations cards; a new photo applies at once.

credit.noPhoto: No photo of its own: uses a room photo

destinations.editName: Change the photo and credit of {{name}}
destinations.emptyHelp: Destinations group rooms by city so guests can filter the Rooms page. Add a room with an address to create one.
destinations.willRemove: The photo will be removed when you save. The card will use a room photo.
destinations.noPhoto: No photo of its own: the card uses the first room photo or a drawing.
destinations.drop: Drop a photo to replace it
destinations.creditHint: Photos under a CC licence need their author and licence; once a licence is set, the details below show on /credits. For the property's own photos, leave the licence empty.
destinations.creditNew: The old photo's credit doesn't apply to the new one: check the fields below before saving.

placeholders.author: e.g. Jane Doe
placeholders.changes: e.g. cropped, resized, converted to WebP

errors.author: An author is needed when the licence asks for credit
errors.url: Links must start with http:// or https://
